original_mapping_command: $p=Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Lxss\*' | Where-Object {$_.DistributionName -eq 'Ubuntu-24.04'}; $w=Join-Path $p.BasePath 'ext4.vhdx'; Write-Output ('Distro: '+$p.DistributionName); Get-Item -LiteralPath $w | Select-Object FullName,Length | ConvertTo-Json; $f=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Docker\wsl\disk\docker_data.vhdx'; Get-Item -LiteralPath $f | Select-Object FullName,Length | ConvertTo-Json; Get-DiskImage -ImagePath $f | Select-Object Attached,DevicePath,Size,FileSize | ConvertTo-Json; Get-Partition -DriveLetter C | Select-Object DiskNumber,DriveLetter,Size | ConvertTo-Json; Get-Disk -Number 0 | Select-Object FriendlyName,BusType,Size | ConvertTo-Json; Get-Volume -DriveLetter C | Select-Object FileSystem,Size,SizeRemaining | ConvertTo-Json
mapping_transformation: CRLF normalized to LF; paths redacted
admin_transformation: transcript header and footer removed; CRLF normalized to LF; trailing blank lines removed
